observations.claim: ScienceAgent.execute aggregates execute_step_with_prefinish_review into agent_reports/science/phase.json. A cached step PASS may enter this phase aggregation without rerunning the current worker/reviewer, and the phase aggregator checks component coverage but does not itself hash-revalidate cached step evidence.

Global finalization is not allowed to trust that phase report alone. run_final_science_prefinish_hooks first calls verify_final_science_lineage, which reloads the current executable plan, science phase report, each per-condition hook/review report and each managed evidence manifest.

verify_final_science_lineage validates each current science evidence payload against the current step, rebuilds each step ArtifactRegistry, runs validate_artifact_contract(review_status=PASS), and the repair contract explicitly requires each managed evidence manifest to have a matching artifact-ledger sha256.

The lineage verifier also checks that phase-level component result fields match the reviewer-approved condition report. If lineage fails, finalization returns FAIL; main.py converts a failed finalization into ok=false/converged=false rather than mission completion.

protocol_implication: Separate EARLY_REPLAY_FRESHNESS from LATE_FINAL_LINEAGE. Xcientist has a step-level cached-PASS freshness gap, but also a later deterministic science-lineage safety net for current managed evidence. Early digest binding remains useful to prevent stale intermediate PASS/reviewer skipping and wasted downstream work; it must not be reported as an unconditional final-integrity failure without a mutation that also defeats finalization.

risk_boundary.not_supported: No claim that a post-PASS mutation of a managed science evidence artifact reaches MISSION COMPLETE; current finalization is designed to reject lineage/artifact-ledger mismatches.
risk_boundary.supported: The step-level replay predicate itself can skip current worker/reviewer/artifact-contract execution, while a separate late finalization verifier rechecks current managed evidence and can fail closed.
